verses.en: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy {our} brother, unto Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellowlabourer,
verses.am: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy {our} brother, unto Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellowlabourer,

verses.en: And to {our} beloved Apphia, and Archippus our fellowsoldier, and to the church in thy house:
verses.am: And to {our} beloved Apphia, and Archippus our fellowsoldier, and to the church in thy house:

verses.en: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.am: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.en: I thank my God, making mention of thee always in my prayers,
verses.am: I thank my God, making mention of thee always in my prayers,

verses.en: Hearing of thy love and faith, which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all saints;
verses.am: Hearing of thy love and faith, which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all saints;

verses.en: That the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus.
verses.am: That the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus.

verses.en: For we have great joy and consolation in thy love, because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee, brother.
verses.am: For we have great joy and consolation in thy love, because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee, brother.

verses.en: Wherefore, though I might be much bold in Christ to enjoin thee that which is convenient,
verses.am: Wherefore, though I might be much bold in Christ to enjoin thee that which is convenient,

verses.en: Yet for love's sake I rather beseech {thee}, being such an one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
verses.am: Yet for love's sake I rather beseech {thee}, being such an one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

verses.en: I beseech thee for my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds:
verses.am: I beseech thee for my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds:

verses.en: Which in time past was to thee unprofitable, but now profitable to thee and to me:
verses.am: Which in time past was to thee unprofitable, but now profitable to thee and to me:

verses.en: Whom I have sent again: thou therefore receive him, that is, mine own bowels:
verses.am: Whom I have sent again: thou therefore receive him, that is, mine own bowels:

verses.en: Whom I would have retained with me, that in thy stead he might have ministered unto me in the bonds of the gospel:
verses.am: Whom I would have retained with me, that in thy stead he might have ministered unto me in the bonds of the gospel:

verses.en: But without thy mind would I do nothing; that thy benefit should not be as it were of necessity, but willingly.
verses.am: But without thy mind would I do nothing; that thy benefit should not be as it were of necessity, but willingly.

verses.en: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season, that thou shouldest receive him for ever;
verses.am: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season, that thou shouldest receive him for ever;

verses.en: Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto thee, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?
verses.am: Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto thee, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?

verses.en: If thou count me therefore a partner, receive him as myself.
verses.am: If thou count me therefore a partner, receive him as myself.

verses.en: If he hath wronged thee, or oweth {thee} ought, put that on mine account;
verses.am: If he hath wronged thee, or oweth {thee} ought, put that on mine account;

verses.en: I Paul have written {it} with mine own hand, I will repay {it}: albeit I do not say to thee how thou owest unto me even thine own self besides.
verses.am: I Paul have written {it} with mine own hand, I will repay {it}: albeit I do not say to thee how thou owest unto me even thine own self besides.

verses.en: Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my bowels in the Lord.
verses.am: Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my bowels in the Lord.

verses.en: Having confidence in thy obedience I wrote unto thee, knowing that thou wilt also do more than I say.
verses.am: Having confidence in thy obedience I wrote unto thee, knowing that thou wilt also do more than I say.

verses.en: But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you.
verses.am: But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you.

verses.en: There salute thee Epaphras, my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus;
verses.am: There salute thee Epaphras, my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus;

verses.en: Marcus, Aristarchus, Demas, Lucas, my fellowlabourers.
verses.am: Marcus, Aristarchus, Demas, Lucas, my fellowlabourers.

verses.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ {be} with your spirit. Amen. «{Written from Rome to Philemon, by Onesimus a servant.}»
verses.am: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ {be} with your spirit. Amen. «{Written from Rome to Philemon, by Onesimus a servant.}»
